app.name: MelosViz
cli.analyze.help: Analyze a WAV file -> RenderSpec JSON
cli.storyboard.help: Generate a beat-synced storyboard JSON from a track + concept
cli.generate.help: Run ComfyUI / C4D / Unreal / AE per scene based on a storyboard
cli.assemble.help: Concat per-scene clips into a master timeline (MediaEncoder / ffmpeg)
cli.master.help: DaVinci Resolve colour + audio mix + master encode
cli.ship.help: Package final deliverables (MP4, ProRes, audio stems, captions)
cli.apply.help: Apply a named preset to a RenderSpec JSON
cli.arg.job_dir.help: Output directory of the full render
cli.arg.lufs_target.help: EBU R128 integrated loudness target: club_pa (-9), youtube (-14), broadcast_ebu_r128 (-23), cinema_pulse (-20)
cli.arg.export_stems.help: Export audio stems (drums / bass / other / vocals via Demucs, or bass / mids / highs fallback)
cli.arg.audio.help: Source audio WAV (used for loudness normalization + stem extraction)
cli.arg.audio_conditioned_video.help: Force audio-conditioned video workflows for drop + chorus archetypes (Wan 2.1 S2V for drops, Seedance A2V for choruses when a character is pinned; falls back to Wan S2V for chorus when no character is set)
cli.arg.concept.help: Concept prompt (e.g. "neon-noir city at midnight, dancer losing themselves")
cli.arg.lyrics.help: LRC / plain-text / JSON lyrics file; snaps scene boundaries to lyric phrases
cli.arg.mood_board.help: One or more reference images (palette + style extracted via PIL median-cut)
cli.arg.moodboard.help: One or more reference images (palette + style extracted via PIL median-cut)
cli.arg.aspect_ratio.help: Delivery-target aspect ratio preset (festival_16x9_4k | youtube_16x9_1080p | club_9x16 | ig_9x16 | instagram_1x1 | cinema_21x9 | vertical_4x5)
cli.arg.continuity_character.help: Pinned subject description that carries across every scene (the protagonist / band / recurring character)
cli.arg.continuity_environment.help: Pinned environment description that carries across every scene (the world / lighting / location)
cli.arg.reference_image.help: Path to an IP-Adapter / style reference image; threads the same face or style into every scene (v2 ContinuityAnchor.reference_image)
cli.arg.character_root.help: Directory containing character-sheet YAML/JSON files or per-character subdirs with reference images (WBS-101..106)
cli.arg.character.help: Named character to enable for this storyboard/generate (repeatable; e.g. --character alice --character bob)
cli.character.help: List or add named characters to a character-sheet registry
cli.character.arg.action.help: Action: 'list' prints registry contents as JSON, 'add' writes one new CharacterSheet
cli.character.arg.description.help: Free-form description of the character for the Director's mood-board prompt
cli.character.arg.style_prompt.help: Style prompt applied alongside the face reference (e.g. fashion editorial lighting)
cli.character.arg.reference.help: Reference image path (use 'front=PATH' / 'three_quarter=PATH' / 'profile=PATH' / 'full_body=PATH' / 'style=PATH' for slot assignment)
cli.character.error.save_failed: viz character add: failed to write character sheet ({error})
cli.error.lyrics_parse_failed: viz storyboard: failed to parse lyrics at {path}: {error}
cli.arg.real.help: Use real adapters instead of mocks (requires tool installs)
cli.error.uvicorn_missing: viz serve: uvicorn is not installed. Install it with: pip install "melosviz[bridge]"
cli.error.no_segments: viz assemble: no per-scene clips found under {path}
cli.error.no_deliverables: viz ship: no MP4 / MOV / WAV / SRT files under {path}
cli.direct.help: Art-director edit: mutate one scene in a storyboard.json, optionally re-render just that scene
cli.direct.usage: viz direct STORYBOARD --scene INDEX [--prompt TEXT] [--camera MOTION] [--name TEXT] [--rerender-only] [--wav PATH] [--render-out DIR]
cli.direct.scene_index_required: viz direct: --scene is required (use --scene 0 for the first scene)
cli.direct.scene_index_out_of_range: viz direct: scene index {index} out of range (storyboard has {total} scenes, valid indices: 0..{last})
cli.direct.wav_required_for_rerender: viz direct: --rerender-only requires --wav so the renderer can recompose the cut
